scope: Observed headers and retry decisions in these frozen configs only; no source-level universal LiteLLM claim. Same primary client fallback policy, no hidden SDK retries.
findings: All LiteLLM recovery failures omit the fixture retry-after-ms header at the client boundary; harness therefore selects seeded_backoff, and early retries occur before the fixture recovery time. Direct/Bifrost/DeskQuota expose the timing header in these responses.
